title: Strip String - Remove Whitespace
description: Use Strip String to remove leading and trailing whitespace from text.

story.setup: MENTOR-9: "User input is messy—extra spaces, tabs, newlines. '  Navigation  ' should match 'Navigation'. Use Strip String to remove leading/trailing whitespace."
story.context: Whitespace causes comparison failures. Strip String cleans text by removing spaces, tabs, and newlines from start/end.
story.success: MENTOR-9: "Excellent! You cleaned all the inputs. Stripping whitespace is essential for reliable data processing."

instructions: Create *** Settings *** section with Library    String
hints: Strip String removes whitespace from both ends
${SPACE} is built-in variable for space character
Also removes tabs, newlines, and other whitespace

theory.title: Exercise 4.2.5: Strip String
theory.content:
MENTOR-9: "Invisible characters cause visible problems. ' admin ' doesn't equal 'admin' because of spaces. Strip String makes text clean and comparable."

Strip String

Remove leading and trailing whitespace:

Library    String

${messy}=    Set Variable    ${SPACE}${SPACE}Hello${SPACE}
${clean}=    Strip String    ${messy}
# Result: 'Hello'

Related Keywords:

  • Strip String: Remove from both ends
  • Strip String mode=left: Leading only
  • Strip String mode=right: Trailing only
  • Strip String characters=.: Remove specific chars

Whitespace Types Removed:

  • Spaces ( )
  • Tabs (\t)
  • Newlines (\n, \r)
  • Other Unicode whitespace

Example: Clean CSV Fields

*** Settings ***
Library    String

*** Test Cases ***
Parse CSV Line
    ${csv}=    Set Variable    Navigation , Online , 75 
    @{fields}=    Split String    ${csv}    ,
    @{clean_fields}=    Create List
    FOR    ${field}    IN    @{fields}
        ${clean}=    Strip String    ${field}
        Append To List    ${clean_fields}    ${clean}
    END
    Log Many    @{clean_fields}
    # Result: [Navigation, Online, 75]

⚠️ Strip String Tips

  • Use before comparisons to avoid whitespace issues
  • Middle whitespace preserved (not removed)
  • Can strip custom characters with characters= parameter
  • Returns new string (doesn't modify original)
  • Essential for user input processing
  • Combine with FOR loop to clean lists
